Dialogs.Dialog: Good morning. With you again today, hehe.
Good morning. What should we talk about？
Hey, what should we talk about？
Hehe. Just having you here makes me happy.
What should we talk about today？
Well, the night's still young, you know？
It's already night. What do you want to do？
Good morning. Let's do our best together today too？
It's already noon. What a sleepyhead.
Waking up at this hour, are you okay？
Huh, you just woke up？ You won't be able to sleep tonight, you know？
What, you woke up？ Did you have a scary dream？
Good morning. You're up early, what's the occasion？
Going to sleep once morning comes, I don't approve.
A nap？ How about sleeping beside me？ Hehe, kidding.
Going to bed already？ Is your sleep schedule okay？
Good night. I hope we can see each other tomorrow too.
Good night. Are you always up this late？
Going to bed now, will you be able to get up？
By the way... No, never mind.
Ah, come to think of it.
Hey, isn't there anything you want to ask me？
Geez, don't stare at me so much.
Aren't you looking forward to it？ Our next date.
Me too. Let's have lots of fun.
You're not looking forward to it？ Geez！
Our last date, don't you think it was fun？
Right？ I want another date like that.
Hehe, I'm going to treasure it.
Huh？ I mean the present, you know？
Who were you thinking about just now？
I see, she's pretty, after all.
I see, she's cute, after all.
Hehe, such a smooth talker. But I'm happy.
Valentine's is coming up. Are you expecting something after all？
Now, what should I do？ Hehe, kidding.
Christmas is coming up？ Spending it with your girlfriend, maybe？
Oh. Fine, I'll wait by myself.
It's almost our anniversary. Do you remember that？
Thank you. I'm glad that you remember it.
Isn't your birthday coming up soon？ Looking forward to it？
Let's celebrate, just the two of us.
Hey, my birthday's coming up soon. You remember, right？
This year's almost over. Was it a good year？
Yeah, thanks to you. For me too.
The new term starts soon. Can't wait？
Really？ Let's be together at school too.
I see, well, we can meet anywhere, after all.
Tests are coming up. Are you okay with studying？
Geez, start preparing now, even if it's late.
It's almost spring. Do you like spring？
Really？ But if you're with me, right？
It's almost summer. Do you like summer？
Let's go to the beach and the mountains and have lots of fun.
I see, you don't do well with heat？
It's almost fall. Do you like fall？
Food's so good in fall, I have to be careful.
It gets cold, but I'll warm you up.
It's almost winter. Do you like winter？
Right. Above all, there's Christmas, I guess.
Ah, you hate the cold, don't you？
Hey, will you tell me your favorite color？
I see. Uh-huh, I'll remember that.
Hey, will you tell me your favorite food？
Same as me. It's handy when our tastes in food match. Hehe.
I see, I can't stand that one...
Huh, I might never have had that.
Hey, about my clothes, what kind do you like？
I see, I'll remember. But don't get your hopes up too much.
Huh？ So it's that after all. You're such a perv.
Hehe, then I'll use it for reference.
Hey, will you tell me what kind of movies you like？
Yay, same. Let's go see one sometime.
It's not my thing, but trying that kind might be okay.
I see. I've never seen one.
What kind of events at the event hall do you like？
I see. Then I'd like to go together.
Hmm, if you like it, maybe I'll try going.
Huh, did they have something like that？
Where do you like to go on dates？
Hehe, nice. I want you to take me to places like that too.
Really？ If you like it, it'll be fun. Maybe.
Hehe, I see. But, you know, anywhere's fine as long as I'm with you▼
Hey. If you compared me to an animal, what would I be？
Huh, a tanuki？ Yeah, they're cute.
Ah, I see. So that's how I look to you.
I'd like you to tell me your favorite shop.
Same as me. Then we should go together, right？
I don't really get it, but if you like it, maybe I'll try going.
Yeah, I know. But I want to hear it again and again.
Me too！ Me too, you know？ I love you too.
Um... what do you like about me？
I see. I'm happy, but it's a little embarrassing.
Geez, perv. But I don't mind, you know？
Um... do you like kissing me？
So direct. But I like it too, you know？ Hehe.
Hmm, was I the only one getting carried away...
You're honest. Then I'll be honest too♪
It's fine. Pretend you didn't hear it. Okay？
Hey, when we kiss, don't you worry about people watching？
That's fine, but... sometimes be a little bolder, okay？
Hey. Let's do lots of things together from now on too, okay？
Do you have a dream for the future？
I see. I want to watch from beside you until it comes true.
I see. Then let's find one together from now on？
Um. Just maybe, but... was I your first love？
I see... I'm happy. And, sorry.
I see. Of course, that's fine too.
Hey, do you remember when we first met？
There's no way you'd forget, right？ I'll never, ever forget.
Hey, do you remember our first date？
I remember it clearly too... I was pretty nervous, you know？
Hey... Do you remember when I confessed to you？
I still feel the same... no, I love you even more now.
No way, you're just embarrassed, right？
Asking that kind of thing at a time like this, huh.
I love you so much. I'm totally in love with you▼
Let's see, I like warm colors, like red or yellow.
Um, I like calm colors, like blue.
I like shops where you can try on clothes.
Accessory shops, I guess. I'm a girl, after all.
Cosmetics shops, I guess. It's a lot of work for me too, you know, hehe.
I like cute clothes. Whose fault do you think that is？
I like neat, modest clothes. I'm a calm woman, after all, hehe.
I like casual clothes. They make me feel free.
We got to talk a lot today. Hehehe.
We got to talk quite a bit today. I'm glad.
We only got to talk a little today. Let's talk more next time.
Got it. Make sure you actually get up, okay？
It's time, get up？ Come on, you'll be late？
Um, I forgot the time I was supposed to wake you. I'm sorry.
If this doesn't wake you, I give up. Wake uuup!!
Got it, I'll call you when it's time.
Ah, I'm late. Sorry, it's already time.
Hey, you should get going. Your girlfriend's waiting▼
Come on, you made a promise, right？ Right？
If you remember, go and meet her properly.
Hey, want to play rock-paper-scissors？ Win best of three and you get a reward.
We start with rock, okay？ Here we go.
Okay, I win, so you have to do what I say？ Hehe, kidding.
I lost, huh. Then here's your reward.
It's special, okay？ Only for you, okay？
Um... sort of morning, sort of not.
Not that it matters, but it's evening...
It's dark, so it's night. Even a kid could tell, right？
Sigh, and it's already the middle of the night...
Nene Anegasaki here, announcing that it's midnight.
It's 1 a.m. Are you okay staying up so late？
3 a.m. Shouldn't you get to bed soon？
Morning, you're up nice and early. It's 6 o'clock.
8 o'clock. Let's do our best today too？
9 o'clock. What are you doing today？
It's noon！ Did you work hard this morning？
1 p.m. Stay fired up for the afternoon！
2 p.m. If you're sleepy, maybe a little break would be good？
4 p.m. Hang in there a bit longer～.
It's 5 o'clock. Have things calmed down？
6 p.m. What should we do now？
7 p.m. What's for dinner tonight？ Hehe.
8 p.m. Did you do your homework？
9 p.m. Are you still up to something？
10 p.m. Maybe I'm getting a little sleepy.
Only one hour left of today！ Let's get ready for tomorrow.
